target: For each integer n>=3, independently sample two uniformly random undirected Hamiltonian cycles C_{1,n} and C_{2,n} on vertex set [n]. Let G_n be their multiset union, retaining a shared edge as two edge occurrences. For each edge occurrence {u,v} with u<v use the factor (x_u-x_v), and let A_n be the coefficient of product_{v=1}^n x_v^2 in the product of those 2n factors. Prove that lim_{n->infinity} Pr[A_n != 0] = 1, or rigorously prove that this limit statement is false.
title: Alon-Tarsi coefficient for a random 4-regular multigraph
